player_prompt.intro:
Yaa kɛɛri {player_id} kɛɛ SimpleTak.
Kɛɛ tabli la, kugri yɛɛri kama '{player_stone}' la, ni kugri yɛɛri kama '{opponent_stone}' la.

Kɛɛri yɛɛri wa, tɛɛri kɛɛ cell kɔɔ (ka kɛɛri index) la, ni kugri yɛɛ kɛɛ.
Kɛɛri misaali, '[12]' kugri yɛɛ kɛɛ cell 12 la.

Kɛɛri yɛɛri la, kugri yɛɛri kɛɛri kɛɛ tabli la (kɛɛri-kɛɛri, kɛɛri-kɛɛri, wɛɛ-kɛɛri, kɛɛ-kɛɛri).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Celli la pɔga {cell_num}. Niŋmi yɛn a ti 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Sel {cell_num} zoe n bee a to pʋgẽ. yãk sel sẽn pa be ye.

action.placement: Jondong {current_player_id} daa la yɛla ({symbol}) tiŋa celli {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Jɛnɛ {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') taabo pʋʋgʋ kɔm pɛndɛ pɛndɛ!
